simple.meaning: תֹּהוּ (tôhûw) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a desolation (of surface), i.e. desert ; figuratively, a worthless thing ; adverbially, in vain.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 1:2. The surrounding context includes land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תֹּהוּ (H8414) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: תֹּהוּ (tôhûw) / H8414 is traced through Genesis 1:2, Deuteronomy 32:10, 1 Samuel 12:21, Job 6:18 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.short: a desolation (of surface), i.e. desert ; figuratively, a worthless thing ; adverbially, in vain
definitions.usage: confusion, empty place, without form, nothing, (thing of) nought, vain, vanity, waste, wilderness.
definitions.full: H8414. tohu תֹּ֫הוּ noun masculine 1Sam 12:21 (Albr ZAW xvi (1896), 112 ) formlessness, confusion, unreality, emptiness (primary meaning difficult to seize; Vrss usually Κενόν , οὐδέν , μάταιον , inane, vacuum, vanum ; compare Lag Or. ii. 60 ; BN 144); — 1 formlessness , of primaeval earth Gen 1:2 (P), of land reduced to primaeval chaos Jer 4:23 (both + וָבֹהוּ and voidness ), Isa 34:11 ׳קַותֿֿ (|| בֹהוּ אַבְנֵי ), 45:18 ת ׳לֹא בְרָאָהּ (|| יְצָרָתּ לָשֶׁבֶת ); 24:10 ׳קִרְיַתאתּ city of chaos (of ruined city); = nothingness, empty space , Job 26:7 ׳עַלתּֿ אֶרֶץ תֹּלֶה ; of empty, trackless waste Deut 32:10 (|| מִדְבָּר ), Job 6:18 ; 12:24 = Psa 107:40 . 2 figurative of what is empty, unreal , as idols 1Sam 12:21 (collective: יוֺעִילוּ לֹא הַתּ ׳אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר ), 12:21 ; Isa 41:29 וָת ׳רוּחַ נִסְכֵּיהֶם , 44:9 (of idol-makers), groundless arguments or considerations, 29:21 בַתּ ׳וַיַּטּוּ צַדִּיק , 59:4 moral unreality or falsehood עַלאתּ ׳בָּטוֺחַ (|| וְדַבֶּרשָֿׁוְא ); = a thing of nought (compare Ecclus 41:10 תהו אל מתהו ), 40:17 (|| אֶפֶס אַיִן ), 40:23 כַּתּ אֶרֶץ ׳שֹׁפְטֵי עָשָׂה (|| לְאַיִן ), worthlessness 49:19 ׳לְת כִלֵּיתִי כֹּחִי וְהֶבֶל (|| יָגַעְתִּי לְרִיק ); as adverb accusative 45:19 I said not, בַקְּשׁוּנִי תֹּהוּ seek me emptily, to no purpose. compare 29:13 וְתֹהוּ ᵐ5 for וַתְּהִי .
